title: Publishing safeguards and deployment checks
why: Owner resumed this follow-up on 2026-11-02: validate public output and demo models/payloads before deploying, using supported integration permissions.

phases.title: Supported workflow permission
phases.useful_alone: The integration can publish authorized workflow edits without adding credentials to the checkout.

items.text: Resolve the GitHub integration workflows permission using the supported LifeOS/GitHub configuration; do not add credentials to this repository.

phases.title: CI build and demo gates
phases.useful_alone: Broken public output or demo/model/payload regressions prevent deployment.
phases.done_when: Both checks run before artifact upload; invalid output is blocked and a real valid workflow run passes.

items.text: Add npm run check:build and npm run check:demos after the Astro/Pagefind build and before GitHub Pages artifact upload; verify broken output/model or payload regressions block deployment and a valid deployment passes.

evidence.value: Workflow now runs check:build and check:demos after Astro/Pagefind and before artifact upload; deploy still needs build. Local valid production output and scientific models/payload budgets pass. Temporary broken internal link, 7 MiB extra JS chunk and isolated incorrect array normalization each fail the respective command with nonzero exit. All fixtures restored/removed.
